item.title: Meal - Crispy Chicken Loaded Fries
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Fries - 400g
  • Chicken breast - 300g
  • Cheese - 1 cup
  • Sauce - 2 tbsp
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook fries until crispy
  2. Cook chicken and slice
  3. Layer fries, chicken and cheese
  4. Melt cheese and drizzle sauce

Macros

  • Calories - 720
  • Protein - 42g
  • Carbs - 60g
  • Fat - 35g
